measured: a frequency grid across the tuner's range; at each frequency the meter for every front-end path and corner code
bench: RTL2832U + R820T-family tuner, 28.8 MHz crystal, behind a USB analyzer with switchable TARGET-A power; no signal source, antenna input sees noise only

RTL2832U + R820T-family tuner, 28.8 MHz crystal, behind a USB analyzer with switchable TARGET-A power; a signal source's transmit port cabled to the antenna input through a 20 dB fixed attenuator, nothing radiating; source levels relative only
candidate_space: frequency 42 MHz to 1002 MHz in 10 MHz steps (the last included) x RFFILT 0..=3 x RFMUX 0..=3 x TF_NCH 0..=15 x TF_LP 0..=15
search: staged: stage A every RFFILT x RFMUX (16) with TF_NCH = TF_LP = 0000 (both corners highest); stage B the two best paths of stage A x every TF_NCH x TF_LP (512). The mux and band fields select a path and the corner codes tune within it; stage A ranks paths with the corners at their least-attenuating codes, so the staging loses nothing unless a path is best only with a corner lowered, which --full at sample frequencies checks
procedure: per frequency: LO for the RF (IF side per --lo-side), PLL words, R16/R20-R22 written, status read; tone on; the source re-levelled at the reference path (RFMUX 01 bypass, RFFILT 00, TF 0000/0000) so the meter sits in its window; then the source stays fixed for every combination at that frequency; per combination R26 and R27 written, 20 ms, a reading of 1 snapshot(s)
line_legend: k ref: the frequency's reference (f, pll, status, relevel, source, m); k bt: f Hz, rf RFFILT, mx RFMUX, n TF_NCH, l TF_LP, m the meter's median, md the medians of every named meter, r raw snapshots; e errors; resumable by (f, rf, mx, n, l)

bit 7 fixed 0; PWD_MIX = 1 on; PW0_MIX = 1 the document's 'normal current'; MIXGAIN_MODE, MIX_GAIN per Front
